Updated On Sep 23, 2026 at 05:05 PM IST

NEW DELHI: Kotak Alternate Asset Managers (Kotak Alts) has announced the final close of its Kotak yield & growth fund at ₹5,000 crore, raised entirely from domestic investors.

The fund had achieved a first close of ₹3,900 crore in February 2026 and has since raised an additional ₹1,100 crore from institutional investors, family offices and ultra-high-net-worth individuals across India.

Kotak yield & growth fund is a category II alternative investment fund and will invest across private credit, real assets and selective growth opportunities.

Eshwar Karra, deputy managing director of the company said said the fund would focus on building a portfolio of cash flow-generating assets through structured credit solutions.
